name: Stability Ball Back Extension
steps: Rest your hips and lower abdomen on the stability ball, brace your feet against the floor or wall and cross your arms.
Relax your upper torso smoothly forward over the curve of the ball while keeping your legs straight.
Contract your lower back and glutes to lift your chest upward until your torso aligns smoothly with your legs.
Pause briefly at neutral alignment, then lower your chest slowly back over the ball under control.
tips: Stop rising once your body forms a straight line rather than snapping into excessive lower-back hyperextension.
Keep your chin slightly tucked so your neck stays aligned with your upper back.
